Ratio Spread — Combined (Indexed)

Equal-weight composite of the 60-day rolling z-score of each ticker’s ATR-normalised distance from SMA20 — ARKK · IWM · HYG · XLY. Signal per ticker: (Close − SMA20) ÷ ATR14.
